security_problem: The optional H32 tools/call adapter accepted an unauthenticated caller-supplied EvaluationRoot. An untrusted MCP client/model could self-assert TRUSTED_USER and satisfy Authorize. Enabled H32 must authenticate the root and bind it to the exact request, session, client, logical server, tool, expiry, and one-use nonce.
required_behavior: Keep settings.instruction_authority_continuity default false and make its enabled path require a policy-pinned Ed25519 assertion from an out-of-band trusted issuer. Strictly decode the existing metadata envelope plus assertion, verify exact signed claims, enforce a maximum 60-second lifetime, atomically consume a 32-byte nonce per Session, call the existing instructionauthority.Authorize exactly once after binding, and strip only the Visor metadata key before every later gate and relay. Preserve unrelated metadata and compose stripping with argument redaction.
failure_behavior: Enabled calls deny with exact contract reasons on missing or malformed envelope/assertion, unknown key, invalid signature, expiration, wrong session/client/server/tool/request/envelope hash, replay, or strip failure. An unsigned self-asserted TRUSTED_USER envelope never authorizes. H32 semantic denial remains terminal and consumes an authenticated nonce. Disabled remains the nil legacy path.
non_goals: modifying the H32 lattice or Authorize semantics
using stdio server identity as client authentication
autonomous push, merge, tag, or release

attack_classes.expected: an unsigned self-asserted TRUSTED_USER envelope denies with instruction authority assertion missing
a second use in the same session denies with instruction authority assertion replayed
wrong session, client, server, tool, request hash, or envelope hash denies with the exact mismatch reason
an assertion at or after expires_at_unix denies with instruction authority assertion expired
the mock server never sees the Visor key; unrelated metadata survives stripping and redaction
omitted or false setting leaves a nil gate and unchanged legacy path
one tools/call observes one coherent policy, key set, and H32 function generation while nonce state survives reload
